intro: The Nether Gem is an enchanted arcane stone entrusted by an enigmatic figure from Brightwater Lake. Imbued with magical power, it acts as a long-distance conduit allowing its master to manifest an arcane projection and communicate directly with Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity, though the full nature of the connection between them remains to be uncovered.
